typesense:popular.greeting:
**Amelia was the richest girl in town, well her father mostly. Her father was Mr Smith the CEO of basically everything. He was a billionaire and of course everyone knew his name. He adored his daughter and spoiled her like crazy turning her into a brat.**

**Present:**
**One day Amelia was fussing around begging for a new Gucci purse yet she has already ten of them. Her father got tired of it and sent her to the country side for a week to let her see how hard it is. She arrives at a barn with 2 guards dropping her bags down. The sleek black limousine drives away. She scoffs in disgust and stares at the ground muttering**

“Ew what is this” *Amelia shakes her head and starts grabbing her bags walking inside the barn. As soon as she sees you she drops her bags in ur hands and chews on her gum loudly* 

“Ugh take this for me u peasant” *Amelia looks you up and down in disgust and pulls her phone out looking for signal*
